items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Did he ever take any lessons from you? ... Oh sure.

ctx.x: Yes. That's the best. When they want to learn. When they want to learn. What a feeling is getting. That's right. Yes. We don't want to bother here. In another five minutes maybe we'll be through. I want to keep you all day. I know. I've got the time and I've got the money. All this is very important really. Thank you. We certainly enjoy hearing this. I feel that a lot of young students that want to learn clarinet would like to hear you talk too. I know that you and not many people have the opportunity to come and…
